text: The screen has to be on to let Brili work. Since this drains our battery fast, it would be nice to still hear the sounds while our screens are off so we can turn on our screens and whipe the cards.
author: Wendy Mobiel
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback regarding the screen issue and notification sounds. We value your input and will take it into consideration. If possible, please send screenshots to our support team at support@brili.com so we can resolve this matter directly.

text: Ziet er niet slecht uit, maar taken bewerken is enorm irritant, je kan niet scrollen doorheen de taken en ze bekijken zonder dat ze mee bewegen en van plaats veranderen, terwijl je net alle moeite hebt gedaan om ze op de juiste volgorde te zetten, dus dan mag je herbeginnen. De app is ook heel traag waardoor het dat proces erg moeilijk maakt en je er echt HEEL lang aan bezig bent. Zonder deze problemen zou het misschien een geweldige app kunnen zijn, maar nu is het frustrerend en zenuwslopend.
author: Sandra Impe

text: Looks good and clear. But I miss the option to import my Google calendar.
author: Ilja Verweij

text: absolute must go app for People with adhd
author: Rafi Wijma
developer_reply: Hi there and thanks for your positive feedback! We're thrilled to hear that you like Brili so much. Keep it up! -- Your Brili Team

author: Kel Wijma
developer_reply: Hi there and thanks for your sharing your feedback! Great to hear that you like Brili so much. Wishing you Happy Routines! -- Your Brili Team

text: Amazing app. But such a shame it isn't possible to buy at once, for life. Especially a lot of ADHD people don't know whether they can afford next months or next years subscription (that why I don't have any, at all. None). And when this is taken away because of the money, it's just another disappointment. But I love the app.
author: Wendy Mobiel
developer_reply: Hi Wendy, thank you for sharing your feedback. We decided to support the app by a subscription model to continuously maintain and improve the app. Nevertheless, we'll consider your suggestion when reviewing our pricing next time. Feel free to get in touch at support@brili.com to learn more. -- Your Brili Team

text: I really like this app, however, I would like it even better if there was an option to schedule small tasks that aren't part of a routine. I also find it way too expensive and therefore won't keep it after the trial period. *EDIT* Suggestion: make a free app with advertising possible next to the paid app.
author: Barbara Chantal
developer_reply: Hi Barbara, thanks for sharing your feedback! We're continuously improving the app and will be happy to consider your suggestion for future development plans. We're supporting the app by a subscription model instead of displaying ads. All subscription payments are used to maintain the app and build more features. Best wishes -- Your Brili Team

text: I love the app but I'm sad it costs so much.
author: cathy kruithof
developer_reply: Hello there and thank you for your feedback. Glad to hear you are enjoying the app! Our number 1 goal is to create a well rounded solution that provides immense value to the Brili community. Stay tuned for seasonal discounts and contact us if you qualify for a student discount. -- Your Brili Team

text: Except from the part where I miss a bit or reporting, this app is a HUGE help for me. A productive morning is so important for a productive day. This app helps me execute my morning routine, even when I'm so tired I'd normally forget a step or two. Oh. And I'd love to have a few widgets so I can easily start a routine from my home screen. Even then, the app is still worth 5 stars. No doubt. Thank you so much for creating this!
author: Mick van Breukelen
developer_reply: Hi Mick, we're so glad to hear that you benefit from using Brili that much! We agree that a good start into the day can make all the difference and we're committed to improve the app continuously for successful mornings. Thanks also for your suggestion of adding widgets, we'll definitely keep this in mind. Best wishes -- Your Brili Team
